definitions.documentation:
HubSpot Upsert Records

Deliberate CRM action for selected objectType; requires matching write scope and confirmWrites=true with $retries=0. Provider validation rules remain authoritative. No generic idempotency header is invented; reconcile uncertain network completion before manual retry. Upsert at most 100 records using a configured unique property. Unique-key upsert improves reconciliation but does not make all business effects exactly once. Email contact upserts are complete updates.

Inputs: `exec`, `request`. Outputs: `next`, `error`, `result`. Configuration follows the inspector schema; no schema defaults are assumed at execution. Missing optional fields stay absent. Provider remainders are retained by codecs. Errors throw and can select a wired error control route.

definitions.documentation:
HubSpot Build Deal Mutation

Build a provider-specific standard/custom property mutation; no external call.

Inputs: `fields`, `custom`. Outputs: `mutation`. Configuration follows the inspector schema; no schema defaults are assumed at execution. Missing optional fields stay absent. Provider remainders are retained by codecs. Errors throw and can select a wired error control route.

Authored 2026-10-20. Provider reference: [official documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api-reference/latest/crm/using-object-apis). New assets are v1; callers must preserve exact dependency pins. Mock tests establish request/codec behavior only; live tenant access is unverified.

## Audited socket contract (21 October 2026)

Inputs:
- `fields`: `@hubspot.type.deal.fields`; required.
- `custom`: `@hubspot.type.properties`; optional (absent stays absent).

Outputs:
- `mutation`: `@hubspot.type.mutation`; required.

Configuration:
No asset-specific configuration.

Known provider records and list elements have structural schemas. Explicit dynamic payloads, selected query results and provider extensions retain the recursive JSON Value vocabulary; they do not imply a known provider entity. Null is distinct from omission. Runtime validates the exact selected immutable type version; reading newer documentation never repins existing graphs. This audit used synthetic fixtures/local mocks and does not establish live provider authorization or delivery.

Library registry key: `hubspot.deal.mutation.build`.

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
